reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which decides missing/number/range for the UI; the diff ignores it and adds a near-identically named getScheduleAmount instead.

duplication.why: Collapses four inline copies into one helper, but the new helper duplicates getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch, which still computes the old midpoint.

placement.why: The new helper sits in shared/schedules.ts, the right module for schedule amount rules.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, the helper and its test are touched.

maintainability.why: Two exported functions with almost the same name now encode different rules for the same question, and schedule-template and every getScheduledAmount caller still plan at the midpoint.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts: new getScheduleAmount bypasses the existing getScheduledAmount instead of changing it; budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount repeats getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch under a one-letter-different name.

one_place.where: The worst-case rule is in getScheduleAmount for forecast, schedules/app and preview, while getScheduledAmount (SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile, useScheduleEdit) and budget/schedule-template.ts keep the midpoint.
